item.title: docs: refresh the README milestone table (2026-11-09)
item.body:
Direct-PR: daily refresh of the README milestone table, under the operator's standing authorization (docs only, self-merged when CI is green).

The problem: the table showed the 2026-11-08 snapshot (M4 4 of 26, M5 0 of 29).

What changed: the snapshot date and two rows (M4 5 of 31, 16 %; M5 0 of 25), from the board render (`tooling/roadmap`): several lots went back to M4 (#655). Nothing else.

Tests: docs only, no code.
